history.summary: FLAG: GENERIC NAME - IDENTITY AMBIGUOUS. 'Shiv Mandir' is a generic name with several listings in and around Naharlagun (on NH-52A near Kali Mandir in E-sector; on Hospital Road; on Doimukh Road; in H-Sector Donyi Polo; at Doimukh). Best candidate is the Shiv Mandir on NH-52A near Kali Mandir, E-sector, Cona, Naharlagun 791110 (Justdial listing, 4.5/31 ratings, with photos, listed hours 6:00 AM-9:00 PM daily) - the most prominent 'Shiv Mandir' actually in Naharlagun town. Coordinates are from a geocoder full-address match to 'Shiv Mandir, Hospital Road, Naharlagun' and are approximate; the E-sector listing pins to approx. 27.10318, 93.694561. No history, founding date or festival calendar could be found for any of the candidate shrines. Media is intentionally empty: a myadhyatm.com image candidate failed to load on preflight (empty server reply) and no other verified image of this specific shrine exists.

name: Shiv Mandir
town_description: Naharlagun, in the Papum Pare district, is the twin town of Itanagar about 12-14 km away and a major commercial hub of the capital region. It hosts the Naharlagun Railway Station, the region's railhead, and lies on NH-52A/NH-415 connecting Itanagar with Assam.

travel.airport: The newer Donyi Polo Airport (Holongi) is the closest airport to Naharlagun (verify distance); Lilabari Airport (Assam) is the older cited option.
travel.railway: Naharlagun Railway Station (NHLN) is in the town itself.
travel.road: The E-sector Shiv Mandir is on NH-52A near Kali Mandir, Naharlagun; autos and taxis run from Naharlagun town and the railway station.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March, the pleasant season in the region.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily (per the Justdial listing for the E-sector shrine; verify on the ground).
